title: RivoLink/leaf
claim: RivoLink/leaf — Terminal Markdown previewer — GUI-like experience.
why_good: A terminal Markdown previewer with a GUI-like feel — pleasant for CLI users, but a small single-purpose utility.
value: Hard to charge for; a free TUI at best with a niche pro tier.
risk: Tiny niche, glow/mdcat exist; a nice tool, not a company.
